title: esm.sh web handler permits unauthenticated reads outside the app directory
summary: Encoded dot segments bypass path containment in web.NewHandler, exposing files outside Config.AppDir with the server process privileges.

severity.rationale: Remote file disclosure can expose developer source, configuration and credentials. The credential risk warrants a 72-hour response.

exposure: Network-facing applications using the vulnerable web.NewHandler are exposed, including configurations with Dev disabled.

remediation.details: Upgrade the web module to 0.2.0 or later and rebuild and restart applications that embed it.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
